notes.title: Map Moderation Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26478329/7e691665211a2d30b27cb1f2bf7d2c3027449efc.png

Lately the moderation team has undergone many changes so that we can continue to publish official maps. This announcement will cover the most important changers to all you mappers out there!

The old moderation system has been replaced! This means you will no longer receive a "pending status" in the form of p3/p2/p1 etc. Instead you will receive one of the many status's on our "Moderation Process" document which is listed below! This form lists all the various states your map could potentially go through whilst it is being moderated. The process of how maps are moderated is also available on this form.

Ranking Criteria for maps has also been changed! The general rules remain the same however quite a few new additions have been made. The "Ranking Criteria" document list's the minimum requirements your map needs in order to be eligible for Official! (This document is also available below)

Lastly, this is the most important change to the moderation system. We will not moderate every map anymore, instead we will moderate maps submitted by mappers through a form. If you're a mapper and you want to have your map moderated you will need to fill out a simple form to notify our mod team. This form is listed below! You can also submit using our discord bot in the official discord server.

All of this may seem very vague or confusing so if you have any questions feel free to ask below or contact a moderator. All of these changes are likely to be updated/changed in the near future, for now this is a trial to see how well this new system will operate!

Links:
Moderation Process

Ranking Criteria

Moderation Submission Form

notes.title: Update 3.6 - Improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/75180826df792a2b70d8f38f01bf821abf6ad43a.png

Hi everyone! Oxy949 is here with some improvements and bug fixes!

 • Core: Added +0.11 sec delay to arcs in map config v.2 
Many "pro" players noticed that arcs in v.2 spawns a little bit earlier. This fix should resolve the problem. (join our Discord for more info)

 • Site: Replay download button added 
Our team loves fair play. From this update, replays are available to download. For now it's only a json file and not playable in game. Old replays are also available but only readable by moderators due to encoding.

 • Editor: Set Player Distance event moved from "Storyboard" category to "Gameplay"
It was moved some updates ago, but many players sugessed it was bug. We moved it there due to "Black Screen option" - the option completly disables Storyboard events, but camera movements is a gameplay feature (check it on maps like Anubis) and can't be disabled.

 • Server connection improvements and status info 
Server performance increase. Game will check server connection and display any problems (such as Steam down and maintenance work)

 • Discord and Twitch links open in OS's browser instead of Steam overlay

 • Minor script performance improvements 

As usual, if you find a bug, please let us know about it here. Have fun!

notes.title: Intralism - Future Update and Localization
notes.notes:
Hi all, Oxy949 here.
At first want to say thanks for all your suggestions and responses! Currently our team working on new major update. Some spoilers without additional info:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/0d64c2bba6b61d74eaecb8578f10ab09c4baa2f1.png

Now every player are able to contribute/improve translations using a collaborative website. If you know English and want to see your language in the game (or your nick in the credits), please check out https://crowdin.com/project/intralism for more information.

Have fun!

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.notes:
Hi all, Oxy949 here.
New major update! There are a lot of changes:

• Added items outline
• Added  crosshair with settings
"Crosshair" indicate correct position for notes
• New "hardcore" mod
Comes with it's own leaderboards. In the hardcore there are no checkpoints, only 1 life and penalty for premature or delayed pressing

• Reworked interface:

Game over screen now have map info

• Added maps list:

Contains 4 groups: featured, new, trend, most voted

• Two hands support
Two hands maps can be created in the level editor (there are new option and new environment (#6) in the level config). By default, left circle control is as normal (W-A-S-D or Arrows) and right circle controlled by I-J-K-L or NUM5-NUM1-NUM2-NUM3. We're still working on this and ready for discussions

• Added input settings
• Added colors in a leaderboards
• Workshop maps now have a "more info" and "Workshop" button
• Back to lobby from multiplayer
• Changed FOV from 37 to 50
• Spectators can now leave with ESC

• Fix for XP from maps
• Auto-subscribtion to created map
• Editor: fix for updating img/ogg
• Fix for locale
• Fix for achievement #20
• Some other bug fixes

Comes with it's own leaderboards. In the hardcore there are no checkpoints, only 1 life and penalty for premature or delayed pressing

• Reworked interface:

Game over screen now have map info

• Added maps list:

Contains 4 groups: featured, new, trend, most voted

• Two hands support
Two hands maps can be created in the level editor (there are new option and new environment (#6) in the level config). By default, left circle control is as normal (W-A-S-D or Arrows) and right circle controlled by I-J-K-L or NUM5-NUM1-NUM2-NUM3. We're still working on this and ready for discussions

• Added input settings
• Added colors in a leaderboards
• Workshop maps now have a "more info" and "Workshop" button
• Back to lobby from multiplayer
• Changed FOV from 37 to 50
• Spectators can now leave with ESC

• Fix for XP from maps
• Auto-subscribtion to created map
• Editor: fix for updating img/ogg
• Fix for locale
• Fix for achievement #20
• Some other bug fixes

notes.title: Upcoming Changes To The Highscore System
notes.notes:
Hi all, Oxy949 here! 

In the upcoming update (probably 1.5) will be changed a highscore system. For now checkpoints don't amends final score. After 1.5 update every restart from checkpoints in the solo mode will give player -1 000 points penalty and reset current combo. 

This changes made to prevent players from infinite replaying, aimed to get the maximum possible score.

As a result of the update, leaderboards will be wiped. (Actually, there is a plan to wipe the leaderboards every month or week, but it's not implemented yet)
